content: SQL Server queue-claim pattern UPDATE TOP(1) WITH (ROWLOCK, READPAST, UPDLOCK) OUTPUT inserted.* WHERE status='pending' is the established idiom (Erik Darling, MSSQLTips): ROWLOCK avoids page/table lock escalation on a queue table, READPAST skips rows locked by other claimants instead of blocking, UPDLOCK prevents two claimants reading the same row before either updates. Matches SPEC.md §5.7 exactly.
